name: Franziskaner Stüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Franziskaner Stüberl in Füssen**

Discover the cozy charm of the **Franziskaner Stüberl**, a beloved traditional tavern nestled in the heart of **Füssen**, right at the foot of the majestic **Alps**. This historic inn, dating back to the 16th century, invites you to savor authentic Bavarian hospitality in a rustic yet refined setting.

Step inside and let the warm glow of wooden beams and flickering candlelight transport you to a bygone era. The **Franziskaner Stüberl** is famous for its hearty **Bavarian cuisine**, where every dish is crafted with care using the finest local ingredients. Indulge in a steaming bowl of **Schweinshaxe** (roasted pork knuckle), melt in your mouth **Käsespätzle**, or treat yourself to a decadent slice of **Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

No visit is complete without trying their signature **Kaiserschmarrn**—a fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into pieces and served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit. Pair your meal with a frothy **Weißbier** (wheat beer) or a glass of **Tyrnauer**, a crisp local wine from the **Inntal** region.

The **Franziskaner Stüberl** is more than just a restaurant—it’s a piece of **Tirol’s** culinary heritage. Whether you're exploring the fairy-tale castles of **Neuschwanstein** and **Hohenschwangau** nearby or simply unwinding after a day of hiking in the **Alps**, this timeless gem promises an unforgettable dining experience. Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere!
